Name: ui-out (strong ease-out)
Use for: UI enter/exit, dropdowns, popovers, toasts, button release

Name: ui-in-out (strong)
Use for: on-screen movement and morphs, tab indicators, programmatic moves
Avoid: entrances (delays the moment the user watches)

Name: expo-out
Use for: hero arrivals, camera push/pull, video arrivals, scroll reveals

Name: cubic-out
Avoid: as the only ease of a whole film (flat default look)

Name: sine-out
Avoid: position moves that must feel decisive

Name: back-out (small overshoot)
Use for: playful arrivals, icons popping, video entries (sparingly)

Name: cubic-in-out
Use for: camera moves, pans, colour floods, layout morphs

Name: sine-in-out
Avoid: idle wobble used to fill time

Name: quart-in
Use for: video exits, zoom through a button

Name: quint-in
Use for: exit side of a cut-the-curve seam

Name: linear
Use for: constant motion: marquee, progress, rotation, scrub-linked scroll, containerAnimation

Name: spring-snappy
Feel: quick with a hint of life

Name: spring-premium (damping 0.75-0.85)
Use for: video morphs, container morphs, product launch films

Name: steps (frame-rate snap)
Use for: line boil, low-fps hand-drawn look, dot-matrix
